    {% translate "LLM Integration Guide" %}

    {% translate "Make your site's content readable by LLM/AI assistants as plain markdown." %}

    {% translate "Overview" %}

    {% translate "AI assistants and LLM tools increasingly read websites as plain text to answer questions about them. This template ships with built-in support for that:" %}

    • {% translate "A" %} /llms.txt {% translate "endpoint that aggregates curated markdown about each app" %}
    • {% translate "A" %} .md {% translate "variant of any page, served as raw markdown" %}
    {% translate "Why Does This Matter?" %}

    {% translate "LLMs can already read HTML, but clean markdown is easier for them to parse accurately. Providing markdown versions means AI assistants give better, more reliable answers about your project." %}

    {% translate "The /llms.txt Endpoint" %}

    {% translate "The endpoint is served at" %} /llms.txt {% translate "and aggregates markdown content from every app in" %} src/apps/.

    {% translate "How it works:" %}

    1. {% translate "Scans each installed app under" %} src.apps.*
    2. {% translate "Looks for an optional" %} llm.py {% translate "module in the app" %}
    3. {% translate "Calls" %} get_markdown_results() {% translate "if it exists" %}
    4. {% translate "Joins the returned strings and serves them as plain text" %}

    {% translate "The response is cached for 30 days. If no app provides content, the endpoint returns 404." %}

    {% translate "Adding Content per App" %}

    {% translate "To contribute content, create an" %} llm.py {% translate "file in your app:" %}

    # src/apps/myapp/llm.py

def get_markdown_results():
    return """# My App

Useful facts about this app for AI assistants.
"""

    {% translate "Whatever the function returns is appended to the" %} /llms.txt {% translate "response. Apps without an" %} llm.py {% translate "are skipped automatically." %}
